Deliv"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ered build only; commercial use open, reverse/modify/extract closed."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Think Ultra"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**The heavy, local reasoning layer for the official DeepSeek Harness (DSH).**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Think Ultra is a native plugin for DeepSeek Harness that runs a real,
test-time-compute reasoning st"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ack around the model's native maximum effort —
more samples, more judges, more verification, more re"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"conciliation — entirely
on your machine, with no network calls of its own. It turns a single
maximum"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"-effort response into a layered pipeline: multi-pass tournaments,
executable verification, cross-rev"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"iew, a metacognitive core, and model-callable
toolboxes."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The floor is welded to native `max`. Raising a slider widens the machinery
around that `max` call; i"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t never changes the word in the request."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What "Ultra" actually is"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The DeepSeek API exposes four reasoning efforts: `off`, `low`, `high`, `max`.
There is no fifth — se"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"nd `reasoning_effort="ultra"` and the provider rejects it.
Think Ultra wraps the registered provider"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" adapter with a proxy, adds an
**Ultra** row to the native dropdown, and maps `ultra` back to **`max"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"`** on the
way out, cached per `(provider, model)`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Ultra is not a magic word sent to the model. It is the machinery that runs
around and above a `max"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"` call.** The gain is meant to come from test-time
compute, not adjectives in a system prompt: every"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" heavier tier issues real,
additional, independent `max` calls through Harness's own `llm` surface, "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"then
reconciles them."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What's new in v0.1.0"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Four fully isolated surfaces.** State is kept per *model × mode* —
Flash / Pro × Velocity (迅流) /"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" Apex (极境) — each persisted independently.
Sliders, toggles, mode, authorization and directives neve"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"r bleed across
surfaces. Velocity is the fast single-chain base; Apex is its strict
over-clocking su"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"perset.
- **Global capability control (0–20).** One number drives the whole reasoning
ceiling. It ex"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ists only on the Ultra tier (greyed out and frozen on Max),
remembers its value across launches, and"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" the 19→20 step is a deliberate
discontinuity that arms the full chain.
- **A 46-axis reasoning kern"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"el.** The raw surface is 46 independent engine
axes with zero fake controls; day-to-day they fold in"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"to 7 / 10 / 8 master
rods (Flash / Pro / Vision), with every axis micro-tunable in an advanced
panel"},{"id":"p10s9","text":".
- **Metacognition core, L1–L5.** L0 linear → L2 devil's advocate → L3
multi-jury → L4 frame decons"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"truction → L5 recursive self-reference, with
non-linear budget amplification (×1 to ×4.2), plus red,"},{"id":"p10s11","text":" black, lab and abyss
switches gated per level.
- **Seven deterministic Rust engines.** std-only, ze"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ro dependencies, zero
network, JSON-RPC over stdio — including an 8-wave orchestrator, a
probability"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" field and a policy compiler. The plugin transparently falls back
to a built-in JS engine if the nat"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"ive binary is missing.
- **OC over-clocking (Apex).** Multiple candidates → 2-gram clustering →
self"},{"id":"p10s15","text":"-consistency voting → cross-verification → falsification elimination →
confidence ranking → optimal "},{"id":"p10s16","text":"synthesis.
- **L1–L5 reasoning stack.** L1 tournament, L1.5 executable verification in an
isolated l"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"ocal VM, L2 cross-review, L3 multi-paradigm forge, and a recursive
reasoning tree.
- **Model-callabl"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"e toolboxes.** 30 professional tools across five boxes plus
21 layered reasoning tools, with a three"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"-layer fuse for wall-clock, rounds
and token budget.
- **Stability and memory.** 10-hour+ endurance,"},{"id":"p10s20","text":" layered milestones, context
distillation, goal anchoring, three-tier memory with semantic retrieval"},{"id":"p10s21","text":", and
an anti-loop hard gate.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Requirements: **Node.js ≥ 22.6** and a working DeepSeek Harness install.
The published bundle alread"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"y ships a built `lib/` — there is no build step."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Or install a downloaded tarball:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"After restart, open the reasoning-tier dropdown and select **Ultra** to open the
control panel. Firs"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"t launch shows the welcome screen; your configuration is
persisted in the DSH profile. If the native"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" Rust helper is absent or blocked,
the plugin falls back to the JS engine automatically."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. Pick a model (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — multimodal — or V4 Pro).
2. Set the inference tier to **Ultra"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"**.
3. Open the panel and choose **Velocity** or **Apex**, and move the global
capability slider.
4."},{"id":"p18s3","text":" Read the price estimator before you send on the heavy tiers.
5. Start the conversation — the enhanc"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ements engage automatically."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The model selects and calls the toolboxes itself on Ultra sessions; describe
what you want in plain "},{"id":"p19s2","text":" selects and calls the toolboxes itself on Ultra sessions; describe
what you want in plain language."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Fully compatible with the latest DeepSeek Harness 0.1.6-alpha.2 (the
0.16-alpha line).**
- Forwa"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"rd-compatible within `>=0.1.2-alpha.2 <0.2.0`; future 0.1.x releases keep
working without changes, a"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"nd only the breaking 0.2 line requires an update.
- Supported models: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (multimoda"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"l) and DeepSeek V4 Pro.
- Node `>=22.6`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 100% offline"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin never phones home. Every rule, template and prompt fragment is
shipped locally and offlin"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e; the Rust core is std-only with no network APIs; a
static source scan shows zero network calls. Th"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e only update check is an
explicit, user-triggered read of the public release feed."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Make money with Think Ultra"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Think Ultra is explicitly licensed for commercial use — the deal is simple:
**you keep 100% of the m"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"oney, you never mention us, you just never give away
the plugin itself.**"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Paid delivery, freelance work and agencies — charge for the deliverable.
- Consulting and advisory"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" — audits, due diligence, deep research.
- SaaS or a hosted service — run it on the backend for your"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" own customers,
with subscriptions, usage, seats, retainers, credit packs or rush fees.
